---
description: Draft release notes from merged pull requests. Use when a release tag is being cut or a changelog entry needs to be written.
---

# Drafting release notes

1. List the pull requests merged since the previous tag.
2. Group them by area using the categories in [the grouping guide](references/guide.md).
3. Write one line per change in the imperative mood.

Read the grouping guide before grouping. Unreleased breaking changes go
first, under their own heading.
